name: git-workspace
description: Clones the target repo into /workspace (or, for a project with no repo, starts an empty one there) and puts the agent on its own <agent-prefix>/<RUN_ID> branch, committing under the agent's own git identity, resuming an existing one when asked. Optionally keeps the agent on that branch.

settings.label: Branch guard
settings.description: Keeps the agent on its own branch: a hook blocks switching or creating branches, and pushes of any other branch (Claude only).

settings.label: Branch prefix
settings.description: Leading segment of each run's branch, <prefix>/<date>-<id>. Default: the agent's own prefix.

settings.label: Base branch
settings.description: Branch new agent branches are cut from. Default: the repo's default branch (origin/HEAD).
